description.desc_thousand_char:
Cheryl Laboratories Pvt Ltd (CLPL), as per its annual filings, is engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading in all types of pharmaceutical products and allied healthcare items. It has its manufacturing facilities in
Maharashtra and Goa. As per the website, the company is engaged in the business of research, development, and manufacturing of skincare and personal care products. It includes sunscreens, face serums, hair serums, shampoo, conditioners, moisturisers, and lotions. Its clients include The Derma, Alkem, Nykaa, Sun Pharma, and Emcure. The company was incorporated in 1987 and has its registered office located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
